description: Return the approved booking links for a hotel (the same links shown to people on staylist.world) plus the Staylist hotel page. Property links open the exact hotel on Trip.com or Klook, where the traveler picks dates and room; preserve these URLs unchanged. Dated offer links, when present, are sorted by total price. The traveler completes checkout on the booking site; this tool cannot book or charge anyone.

checkin.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide both dates or neither

checkout.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format; provide both dates or neither

hotel_id.description: Exact hotel id returned by search_hotels
